subject.summary: The owner's Herman Miller Eames Lounge Chair (670) and Ottoman (671): three moulded plywood shells with leather cushions, the arms bridging seat and back, a five-star swivel base, and the ottoman on a four-star base. Sizes from Herman Miller's published Classic dimensions; profiles traced from the owner's two photos.

identity.feature: three moulded plywood shells (seat, back, headrest) with the light ply edge
the reclined stepped profile: seat, lumbar back and a more upright headrest, joined by back braces
arm pads bridging the seat ear and the back shell
five-star swivel base; ottoman on a four-star base
